entities.summary: The Agricultural Palace is a building in the historic center of Kazan, in the Vakhitovsky District. It is located on Palace Square, near the northern wall of the Kazan Kremlin and the Kazanka River embankment. The building accommodates the headquarters of the Ministry of Agriculture and Food of the Republic of Tatarstan, the Chief Veterinary Office, the Republican Agro-Industrial Center for Investments and Innovations, and a number of subordinate organizations. The Palace of Farmers has become one of the city’s most notable contemporary landmarks.
